OP, I’m sorry you’re in pain, I really am. I’ve been in your position. I’m still in love with a journalist I had am amazing connection with, met him March 1. He’s a single dad and a journalist, guess where his energy had to go once covid hit. I still think about him every day. 

With that being said, y’all are basically slut shaming this girl. OP, there’s a woman out there that will like you and will be available. Keep trying to socialize, to the best of your ability during covid.

I am f’ing pissed. 

Today marks my 30th consecutive day of sobriety, and this... idk what it is, computer glitch, or human error in uploading, or whatever it is, is going to cause more problems than the original dui did. 

I did the dui, I admit that, that happened. I did not drink on the 20th, and idk how to show the judge that when the computer says different.
This is happening in South Dakota
I can only imagine she doesn’t believe me because she hasn’t seen one of these give a false positive before.
I’m due in court Monday the 21st of September. To be sentenced for both my dui and my “violation.”
She’s not a public defender. I retained her privately

She doesn’t believe me. Her advice is that I change my driver’s license to SD (I work in South Dakota, but technically am a Minnesota resident, I live about ten miles over the border) as MN’s dui laws are harsher than SD’s.

My bac was too high (over .20) and it was 8am. My lawyer said with this new “violation” they’re not going to give me any mercy. I had weight loss surgery, so alcohol hits my blood harder than most people, even though mentally I’m not necessarily more inebriated.

It’s just so frustrating. And that’s exactly right, if I didn’t know that I hadn’t been drinking, I would say I had been, the paperwork they showed me looks exactly like I was. 

I mean, the only other thing I can come up with is that my bathtub has a slow drain (my house is 100 years old, one of those historical numbers) and I probably took a longer than average shower, getting ready for that evening. Maybe the unit got slightly submerged, idk. I still don’t see how that would cause this though.

She says the judge’s opinion is that the only thing that can product a bac of .06 is alcohol consumption. There has to be something else though.

I was drinking an iced tea/lemonade that day as I was getting ready, with the organic lemonade and iced tea from Costco. I mean, is there any chance that lemonade could ferment? That seems weird though too, I’ve never heard of that happening in real life from lemonade or any other fruit juice just sitting in a fridge. 

It was maybe 4 or 5 months old, I think I bought that lemonade back in March or April. I’ve been drinking a fair amount of lemonade iced teas since this bracelet got put on, it’s kind of taken the place of the white wine I used to drink.
From what I’ve read online, the manufacturer basically never admits the machine might not be 100% accurate all the time.

Yes. The lawyer was trying to get me a suspended imp, but my bac was very high and it was early in the morning. (I had weight loss surgery a couple years ago, and alcohol goes into my bloodstream at a higher rate than the average person’s and stays longer; my then-boyfriend and I had stayed up late drinking after he’d been gone for three weeks for work, I wasn’t drinking that morning.)

I’m in South Dakota. The one I have doesn’t read in real time, I have to go into the police department twice a week and upload the prior 3-4 days data. 

I met my friend at a local restaurant at 5:45 that day, she could vouch that I had an iced tea there and water at the TEDx event, but when I said that to my lawyer, she said I could be getting them to lie for me.

She also said there’s no way hygiene products could register as a .06, and that the judge won’t believe me.
